hero.title: Everything You Need to Manage Import & Export Operations
hero.description: Manage shipments, products, suppliers, documents, compliance, and business insights from one connected platform.

howItWorks.title: How Your Operations Work in One Platform
howItWorks.description: A simple and connected workflow that helps your team manage products, suppliers, shipments, and company documents — all from one centralized dashboard.

step1.title: Manage Your Products & Suppliers
step1.body: Add and organize your products, manage supplier information, and keep all related data structured in one place.

step2.title: Create & Track Shipments
step2.body: Create shipment requests, manage approvals and purchase orders, and track every shipment from request to arrival and stock.

step3.title: Stay on Top of Documents & Performance
step3.body: Manage company and product documents, monitor registration requirements, and use reports to understand shipments, products, suppliers, and import performance.

challenges.title: From Operational Challenges to Complete Control
challenges.description: Identify the challenges slowing down your operations—and bring everything together in one connected platform.

card1.title: 1. Shipment information is scattered
card1.body: Data trapped in legacy email chains, random spreadsheets, and disconnected carrier portals makes tracking impossible.

card2.title: 2. Documents are difficult to track
card2.body: Customs declarations, bills of lading, and commercial invoices are buried, leading to lost time and clearance blockages.

card3.title: 3. Supplier collaboration is manual
card3.body: Constant timezone differences, manual follow-ups, and unacknowledged messages stall production lines.

card4.title: 4. Expiring documents & delayed shipments
card4.body: Late alerts on permits, missed compliance deadlines, and unexpected demurrage fees compound operational risks.

features.title: Built Around Your Import & Export Operations
features.description: Simplify complex import & export workflows with a connected platform designed to give your team better visibility, stronger control, and faster decision-making.

feature1.title: Manage Every Shipment From One Place
feature1.description: Create, track, and manage your shipments from request to completion with clear status visibility, organized information, and a centralized workflow.
feature1.check2: Clear visibility across every shipment stage

feature2.title: Stay on Top of Every Requirement
feature2.description: Keep required documents and registration requirements organized while staying aware of expiry dates, document status, and outstanding requirements.
feature2.check2: Clear visibility into document and registration status
feature2.check3: Keep product requirements organized in one place

feature3.title: Connect Products, Suppliers & Requirements
feature3.description: Manage products and suppliers together with their related information, documents, and registration requirements for a clearer view of every business relationship.
feature3.check2: Connect products with their related requirements
feature3.check3: Keep supplier relationships organized and accessible

feature4.title: Control Access Across Your Organization
feature4.description: Manage roles and permissions to ensure every team member has the right level of access across your platform.
feature4.check3: Keep your operations secure and organized

shipmentManagement.title: Complete Shipment Lifecycle Control
shipmentManagement.description: From creation to delivery, manage every aspect of your import shipments. Track real-time KPIs - Total Shipments, In Transit, Arrived, Delivered, and Delayed - with a multi-step creation wizard and detailed shipment views.

feature1.title: Multi-Step Creation Wizard
feature1.description: 3-step guided flow: General Info → Products → Review & Submit

feature2.title: Real-Time Status Pipeline
feature2.description: Track shipments through Created → Approved → In Transit → Arrived → Delivered

feature3.title: Detailed Shipment Views
feature3.description: Overview, Documents, and Products tabs with full shipment timeline

feature4.title: Smart Filters & Export
feature4.description: Filter by status, supplier, amount paid. Export and bulk manage 247+ shipments
